name: LEMP Stack
summary: nginx, MariaDB and PHP-FPM on Ubuntu 24.04 with a ready application database and a placeholder site.
notes: Packages come from the Ubuntu 24.04 archive (nginx, MariaDB 10.11, PHP 8.3-FPM) and receive security updates automatically. MariaDB listens on localhost only. Site files live in /var/www/html. With a domain, the site is served on http first and Let's Encrypt is requested through certbot; if DNS is not ready, a systemd timer retries hourly until it succeeds and then disables itself. Without a domain the site is served on plain http at the server IP.
